## Ticket Reports

#### <span id="FinalFormTicket"></span><a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Final Form Ticket">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />

<img src="data:image/bmp;base64," class="Icon" /> Final Form Ticket</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Final Form Ticket">

Compiles measurement and accounting data for the following ticket types:

- Scale
- Cavern Level
- Tank Run and Tank Gauge
- Meter
- Blow Down
- Flare
- Conversion

To run this report, open the Ticket Editor or Ticket Search and right-click a ticket.

The Component Section contains:

- All component data available for the ticket, out to the highest component.
- Alkenes and neopentane if the "Show Alkenes" and "Show Neo-pentane" options are enabled for the ticket.
- Component mass data for meter tickets using the mass-based calculation method. In this case, the report displays density values for each component from the HC Properties data.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="Icon" style="width: 15;height: 15;" /> FLOWCAL first looks at the ticket for HC properties (set on the Analysis tab), then falls back to the source, then back to the system-level HC properties.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="Icon" style="width: 15;height: 15;" /> View Sample Report:

- <a href="../../../Resources/PDFs/Report%20Examples/Final%20Form%20Ticket%20-%20Meter%20(Table%20A).pdf" target="_blank">Final Form Ticket - Meter (Table A)</a>
- <a href="../../../Resources/PDFs/Report%20Examples/Final%20Form%20Ticket%20-%20Meter%20(Table%20E).pdf" target="_blank">Final Form Ticket - Meter (Table E)</a>
- <a href="../../../Resources/PDFs/Report%20Examples/Final%20Form%20Ticket%20-%20Scale.pdf" target="_blank">Final Form Ticket - Scale</a>
- <a href="../../../Resources/PDFs/Report%20Examples/Final%20Form%20Ticket%20-%20Upright%20Tank%20Run.pdf" target="_blank">Final Form Ticket - Upright Tank Run, API 12.1.1 (2011)</a>
- <a href="../../../Resources/PDFs/Report%20Examples/Final%20Form%20Ticket%20-%20Horizontal%20Tank%20Gauge.pdf" target="_blank">Final Form Ticket - Horizontal Tank Gauge</a>

</div>

#### <span id="FinalFormTicketAllowed"></span><a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Final Form Ticket Allowed">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />

<img src="data:image/bmp;base64," class="Icon" /> Final Form Ticket Allowed</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Final Form Ticket Allowed">

Compiles measurement and accounting data for the same tickets as Final Form Ticket reports, and also displays the net allowable amounts by component and net allowable total for a ticket. When the component volumes are in US customary units, the report will always display component volumes and component volume net allowable amounts in gallons.

To run this report, open the Ticket Editor or Ticket Search, right-click a ticket and select **Print Ticket(s)** \> **Ticket Allowables**. This report is also available from the Ticket Detail Editor by clicking the drop-down on the Print button and choosing **Print Allowables** or **Print Allowables with Internal Notes**

The Component section contains:

- All component data available for the ticket, out to the highest component.
- Alkenes and neopentane if the "Show Alkenes" and "Show Neo-Pentane" options are enabled for the ticket.
- Component mass data for meter tickets using the mass-based calculation method. In this case, the report displays density values for each component pulled from the HC Properties data.
- When the report is run for a ticket using US Customary units, the component volumes and net allowable values are in gallons, regardless of component volume units on the ticket.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="Icon" style="width: 15;height: 15;" /> For density values displayed on the report, FLOWCAL first looks at the source to determine which HC properties values to display, then the system-level HC properties.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="Icon" style="width: 15;height: 15;" /> View Sample Report:

- <a href="../../../Resources/PDFs/Report%20Examples/Final%20Form%20Ticket%20Allowed%20-%20Meter%20(Table%20A).pdf" target="_blank">Final Form Ticket Allowed - Meter (Table A)</a>
- <a href="../../../Resources/PDFs/Report%20Examples/Final%20Form%20Ticket%20Allowed%20-%20Meter%20(Table%20E).pdf" target="_blank">Final Form Ticket Allowed - Meter (Table E)</a>
- <a href="../../../Resources/PDFs/Report%20Examples/Final%20Form%20Ticket%20Allowed%20-%20Scale.pdf" target="_blank">Final Form Ticket Allowed - Scale</a>
- <a href="../../../Resources/PDFs/Report%20Examples/Final%20Form%20Ticket%20Allowed%20-%20Upright%20Tank%20Run.pdf" target="_blank">Final Form Ticket Allowed - Upright Tank Run, API 12.1.1 (2011)</a>
- <a href="../../../Resources/PDFs/Report%20Examples/Final%20Form%20Ticket%20Allowed%20-%20Horizontal%20Tank%20Gauge.pdf" target="_blank">Final Form Ticket Allowed - Horizontal Tank Gauge</a>

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Liquid Rail BOL Ticket">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />

<img src="data:image/bmp;base64," class="Icon" /> Rail Car Ticket</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Liquid Rail BOL Ticket">

Displays pertinent volume BOL data per US DOT requirements. Run this report from the Ticket Editor and Ticket Search for rail car tickets.

<a href="../../../Resources/PDFs/Report%20Examples/Rail%20Car%20Ticket.pdf" target="_blank">

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="Icon" style="width: 15;height: 15;" /> View Sample Report</a>

</div>

You can run some ticket reports for individual tickets while you are viewing them in the Ticket Editor or Ticket Search. You can use the context menu on the ticket or click **Print** on the Ticket Detail form to preview or email the reports.

## Miscellaneous Reports

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Cavern Batch Summary">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />

<img src="data:image/bmp;base64," class="Icon" /> Cavern Batch Summary</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Cavern Batch Summary">

This report matches the Inventory Batch Summary run from the Standard Reports menu. It displays net standard volume amounts on batches that are injected into or withdrawn from the selected cavern. This report is run from the Batch tab of the Liquid Cavern Editor.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="Icon" style="width: 15;height: 15;" /> <a href="../../../Resources/PDFs/Report%20Examples/Cavern%20Batch%20Summary.pdf" target="_blank">View Sample Report</a>

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Helium Measurement">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />

<img src="data:image/bmp;base64," class="Icon" style="width: 15px;height: 15px;" /> Helium Measurement</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Helium Measurement">

Runs for meters defined as helium meters in the Meter Editor. Displays the following values at an hourly, daily, or monthly resolution:

- Total Net Helium
- Gross 50 to 65% Helium
- Net 50 to 65% Helium
- Gross less than 50% Helium
- Net less than 50% Helium



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="Icon" style="width: 15;height: 15;" /> The hourly, daily, and monthly Helium Measurement reports are shipped with FLOWCAL, but are not installed by default. To install these reports, copy the reports from the Crystal folder to the Crystal\Custom folder and add the reports to FLOWCAL using the **Add Report** menu.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Inventory Location Definition">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />

<img src="data:image/bmp;base64," class="Icon" /> Inventory Location Definition</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Inventory Location Definition">

Displays volume, energy, and mass for each periodic inventory record on an inventory location (gas inventories), or GSV, NSV, and mass for each periodic inventory record on a cavern location (liquid inventories). Run this report from the Inventory Editor and Liquid Cavern Editor.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="Icon" style="width: 15;height: 15;" /> <a href="../../../Resources/PDFs/Report%20Examples/Inventory%20Location%20Definition.pdf" target="_blank">View Sample Report</a>

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Location Inventory Ticket">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />

<img src="data:image/bmp;base64," class="Icon" /> Location Inventory Ticket</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Location Inventory Ticket">

Displays total volume and mass inventory, component volume and mass inventory, and % from the selected revision of an inventory location. To run this report, right-click on a revision in the revisions grid of the Location Close Revisions form. This report is only available for inventory locations.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="Icon" style="width: 15;height: 15;" /> <a href="../../../Resources/PDFs/Report%20Examples/Location%20Inventory%20Ticket.pdf" target="_blank">View Sample Report</a>

</div>
